answer: The lagoon multiplier is published, charged in shale, and forge lists each payment. The admission burn is multiplied by 5 for each account already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival forfeits the most. A burst of registrations as a result prices itself out, because the marginal alias costs more than the first by design. A farm of 4280 identities would post 3774 proofs and burn roughly 30 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
